answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we employ Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must lock $1,000 in a smart contract. Second, the hardware enclave generates a unique cryptographic proof. Third, nodes verify this proof against the bonded stake. This ensures no hollow, fake identities can exist without significant cost. An attacker would need $50,000 in bonds and 14 days of hardware setup to scale. This protects the nectar of rewards for true participants. It functions like a walnut; the hard, outer shell protects the precious, sweet center from any empty, parasitic threats.
